|game_text=If Agents In the Court on table, deploy on table. No Love For The Empire may not flip. Bo Shuda may not be canceled. Your characters at Tatooine sites may not be attacked. During your deploy phase, may use 1 Force to deploy a Tatooine battleground location from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
|errata_history=Versions of [[Yarna d'al' Gargan (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court]], in date order (2 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Yarna d'al' Gargan (V) (Virtual Set 8)]]): release sheet “Virtual Set #8” (Players Committee; released 24 November 2004; PDF dated 24 November 2004), page 2, slip 24 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20041205113015/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/VirtualSet8Final.pdf VirtualSet8Final.pdf on swccgpc.com] (Internet Archive capture of 5 December 2004), announced in the [https://web.archive.org/web/20041204170841/http://www.swccgpc.com/interior.htm Committee's news post of 24 November 2004]: “Deploy on table. While Agents In The Court or No Love For The Empire on table, Bo Shuda may not be canceled, creatures cannot attack your characters at Tatooine sites, and once per deploy phase you may use 1 Force to ▼ a Tatooine battleground location. While No Love For The Empire on table, it may not flip.” The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “8•24” at bottom right and no expansion icon.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071026143738/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards8.pdf Internet Archive capture of 26 October 2007; later 2007 re-edits included], slip 24), in the Committee's Remaster template: “If Agents In the Court on table, deploy on table. No Love For The Empire may not flip. Bo Shuda may not be canceled. Your characters at Tatooine sites may not be attacked. During your deploy phase, may use 1 Force to deploy a Tatooine battleground location from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
